sources.title: Digital Connectivity Portal
sources.facts: Guidance for local authorities and network providers on local digital connectivity and infrastructure deployment.
sources.guard: Portal guidance does not prove a particular address is served or a project is deliverable.

sources.title: Digital and telecoms: resources for local authorities
sources.facts: Covers planning, street works, public assets and regulation for digital infrastructure deployment.
sources.guard: A resource collection does not establish site-specific rights, consent or capacity.

sources.title: Guidance for the local planning authority
sources.facts: Explains how local plans and development management can support fixed and mobile infrastructure.
sources.guard: Planning guidance is not permission for a mast, cabinet, fibre route or small cell.

sources.title: NPPF: supporting high quality communications infrastructure
sources.facts: Sets national policy for electronic communications networks, masts and full-fibre provision.
sources.guard: National policy does not prove exact-site acceptability, capacity or planning approval.

sources.title: Code of practice for wireless network development in England
sources.facts: Sets good-practice roles for operators, agents, contractors, LPAs and other stakeholders.
sources.guard: A code of practice does not prove compliance, consultation outcome or consent.

sources.title: Guidance on access agreements
sources.facts: Explains wayleaves, leases, consideration and compensation for digital-infrastructure access.
sources.guard: General access guidance does not prove an agreement binds a specific site.

sources.title: Legislation and regulation
sources.facts: Explains the Code framework, Ofcom's role and operator-status guidance.
sources.guard: The legal framework does not prove operator status, imposed rights or dispute outcome.

sources.title: Check your gigabit broadband availability
sources.facts: Explains the England and Wales address checker and its data-update and accuracy limitations.
sources.guard: Checker output can change and does not prove installation, service quality or contract availability.
